is_anopheles.evidence: The study uses Anopheles gambiae and Anopheles coluzzii (Title, Page 1).

reports_target_markers.evidence: While the paper mentions Vgsc L1014F (kdr) and Ace-1 G119S as being present in the Tiassale strain (Page 9), it does not report genotyping results for the mosquitoes used in this study; it refers to the known characteristics of these laboratory strains.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: The paper does not provide genotype counts (RR/RS/SS) or allele frequencies for the target markers in the samples tested.

african_field_population.evidence: The study exclusively uses laboratory colonies: Anopheles gambiae (Kisumu and Tiassale strains) and An. coluzzii (Ngousso strain) (Page 9). No field-collected mosquitoes were genotyped.

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary empirical study evaluating a new spectroscopy method.

sub_country_location.evidence: The origins of the laboratory strains are specified: Yaoundé (Cameroon), southern Cote d'Ivoire, and Kenya (Page 9).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No collection dates are provided for the mosquitoes used, as they are from established laboratory colonies.

duplicate_risk.evidence: The study uses standard laboratory colonies (Kisumu, Ngousso, Tiassale) for method development.

supplement.evidence: The paper is ineligible based on the use of laboratory colonies and lack of genotype data; supplementary files would not change this status.

assessment.summary: This study evaluates the use of micro diffuse reflectance spectroscopy (µDRIFT) on mosquito legs to identify species, age, and cuticular insecticide resistance in laboratory-reared Anopheles gambiae s.l. The study used established laboratory colonies (Kisumu, Ngousso, and Tiassale) and did not report new genotype data for field populations.
exclusion_reasons: Only laboratory colonies used (Kisumu, Ngousso, Tiassale), no field population genotyped.
No extractable genotype data (counts/frequencies) reported for the target markers; resistance status is based on known strain characteristics from previous studies.
